stations.title: Intake
stations.text: A repair is made first, filled in later.

stations.title: Kasimir's rack
stations.text: Every repair on it is whole from the start.

captions: Kasimir finds a repair on the bench with no ticket and a strange number of minutes.
At intake a repair is made first and filled in later, and sometimes later never comes.
You write constructors that give a repair every value the moment it is made.
Now every repair that reaches the rack has its ticket, its item and its minutes.
Repairs start right now. Next, Dorrit's screen reads them without changing them.
